summary: Replaced greedy booking with exact chronological global assignment search, resolving civil folds and gaps, enforcing dependencies, room blocks, and consecutive-person directed setup, and applying deterministic value/count/ASCII tie-breaking without modifying inputs.
tests_run: Ran public.test.mjs and candidate.test.mjs through the tests tool: 10 tests passed, 0 failed.

Candidate tests include 50 deterministic comparisons against an independent exhaustive assignment oracle, plus optimization, transition, dependency, room/block, range, preservation, and civil-time cases.
limitations: Exact search is exponential and scoped to the specified maximum of ten meetings and three rooms.
Civil-time conversion relies on Node/Intl time-zone data and the specified five zones in 2024–2026.
Inputs are assumed well formed; validation is representative rather than exhaustive over the entire input domain.
